descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Graffiti 6 puts a pressure washer in your hand.

CLEAN IT
The golden-hour alley arrives covered in years of faded throw-ups, tags and city grime. Nothing wipes a wall in this game - you blast it clean. The water lands exactly where you aim: grime peels off in clean stripes, old paint washes away, and the brick goes dark and wet, then dries in the sun.

THE WASHER
The CITIVIEW PRO 3000 hangs on its red cart with a real hose. Twist the tip between a red pencil jet that cuts a sharp line and a white fan that sweeps whole rows - and throws a rainbow when the sun is behind you. The jet even knocks cans across the table and blasts stencils off the wall.

PAINT IT
Eight CITIVIEW spray cans, skinny, medium and fat caps, 32 stencils from A to Z, real mist and drips. Spray on freshly washed brick and your paint runs down the wet wall, just like the real thing.

SPOTLESS
A clean meter floats over the gun as you work. Take a wall to spotless for a chime and sparkles, light up all 13 walls on the cart's board, then hit RE-BOMB and the vandals are back for another job.

THE ALLEY
Six real brick sets with deep relief, wet cobbles, a fire escape and loading doors - and six looks: golden hour, high sun, sun shower, snow day, first light and autumn gold.

Controls: grip to pick up the washer or a can, trigger to wash or spray, A/X twists the nozzle, X colours, A caps, Y photo, left MENU for looks, re-bomb and music.
